Definition: Gazez, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Gazez is the name of two Israelites in one verse of the genealogy. Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bore Haran, and Moza, and Gazez, in 1 Chronicles 2:46, and Haran begat Gazez — a second man of the same name, son of the first. The name appears only here, in the family of Caleb.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the double Gazez shows how families repeat the names they love. A father names his son for his brother, and the name lives twice in one verse; I hold that God keeps the families of Caleb as carefully as He keeps the kings.
